class: A long-running process that appends every event to an in-memory list kept for tests or status (checks run, errors) grows without end: at production rates it exhausts memory in hours, and no short test shows it.
mechanism: GC-MU step 4: Worker.checks and Worker.errors were plain lists appended on every check; 1,000 strategies checked each second add about 21.6 million entries in one 6-hour market day.

first_seen.where: GC-MU step 4 round 3, found by the orchestrator reading the merged diff

fix: b5264ccc: _keep_recent keeps the last RECENT_KEPT = 1000 entries; test_recent_checks_and_errors_are_bounded.

detection.note: The instance is tested; no scan finds other unbounded in-memory lists in long-running roles.
